headline: The plumbing checkout defends itself
lede: When live ASTEROIDS work showed up uncommitted inside the plumbing checkout (#3730's ghost, filed as #3735), the law said read-only but nothing enforced it. Today the invariant got teeth: plumbguard parks foreign dirt verbatim and restores HEAD truth, forge-merge refuses to clean over an ambiguous tree, and a new sandbox check replays the exact incident.

notes.text: PR #3751 → ac9968a: scripts/lib/plumbguard.mjs (check/park, STATE.md the sole allowance, /tmp/forge/corpse-<stamp>/ preserves every byte of the flight), forge-merge.sh preflight park-and-refuse, FORGE.md step 1 now park-then-proceed instead of halting lanes.

npm run plumbingcheck (27/0) replays the #3730 shape in mergecheck's sandbox — dirt parks verbatim, merge completes over the restored tree, park-failure refuses with gh pr merge never fired; proven red by deleting the park line. mergecheck refactor still 59/0.

A new *check alias must be wired into scripts/checks.mjs or ciscope --selftest reds static in ~7 s (#1575). Main health = main-ok.sh's nightly signal; stale November dispatch runs in gh run list are noise. The 13:16Z writer itself stays unnamed — but if it strikes again, the park dir now names it.
